elements.name: play
elements.brief: Build a sample from a ZzFX parameter list and play it in one call.
elements.description: Build a sample from a ZzFX parameter list and play it in one call.

elements.name: samplerate
elements.brief: Set the sample rate used to render subsequent samples. Defaults to 44100.
elements.description: Set the sample rate used to render subsequent samples. Defaults to 44100.

elements.name: play_sample
elements.brief: Play a sample previously returned by {@link build_sample}.
elements.description: Play a sample previously returned by {@link build_sample}.

elements.name: build_sample
elements.brief: Build a reusable sample from a ZzFX parameter list, without playing it.
elements.description: Build a reusable sample from a ZzFX parameter list, without playing it.
